Constructs the full free-source input matrix of an actual allowed word and proves its joint operator-norm bound. A single source-independent endpoint-map word derives the same bound for proper source frames. Exact rectangular ket-bra trace identities and the number of unordered source pairs are proved. The chronological affected/exterior separation, actual Schmidt-frame substitution, Gaussian source replacement and circuit trace-norm error estimates remain separate obligations.
